quests.title: The Wayfarer's Proving
quests.description: Complete Warden Halrik's proving trials across the five landmarks of the Proving Isle to earn your Wayfarer Charter.

stage_01_briefing.description: Speak with Warden Halrik in the Proving Courtyard to receive your proving orders.

objectives.text: Speak with Warden Halrik in the Proving Courtyard

stage_02_trials.description: Travel to the Old Watchtower Ruins, defeat the Raider Duo, and solve the Rune-Carved Archway riddle.

objectives.text: Defeat the Watchtower Raider Duo in the Old Watchtower Ruins
Solve the Rune-Carved Archway riddle in the Old Watchtower Ruins

stage_03_beacon.description: Climb Proving Beacon Cliff, defeat the Cinder-Horn Sentinel, ignite the Wayfarer Beacon, and return to Warden Halrik.

objectives.text: Defeat the Sentinel and ignite the Wayfarer Beacon
Report back to Warden Halrik in the Proving Courtyard

quests.title: Blade & Crucible
quests.description: Learn both crafting systems from Artisan Brann: forge an item in Craft & Forge and combine two items in Inventory.

objectives.text: Craft any item on the Craft & Forge tab
Combine two compatible items in your Inventory (e.g. Whetstone + Spear)
Report back to Artisan Brann on Ember Forge Terrace

quests.title: Fang & Shrine
quests.description: Help Scout Pippin drive off the Briarthorn Wolf stalking Whispering Grove.

objectives.text: Defeat the Stray Briarthorn Wolf in Whispering Grove
Report back to Scout Pippin in Whispering Grove

quests.title: The First Warden's Signet
quests.description: Your keen search of Whispering Grove uncovered the hidden Signet of the First Warden. Show it to Warden Halrik in the Proving Courtyard.

objectives.text: Show the Signet of the First Warden to Warden Halrik
